+class TestNoLogSanitization(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_remove_values_only_changes_string_values(self):
+        original = {'secret': 'secret and secret', 'nested': ({'secret-key': b'secret!'}, 7, False, None)}
+        result = remove_values(original, (b'secret',))
+        self.assertEqual(result, {'secret': '******** and ********',
+                                  'nested': ({'secret-key': b'********!'}, 7, False, None)})
+        self.assertEqual(original['secret'], 'secret and secret')
+        self.assertIs(type(result['nested']), tuple)
+
+    def test_remove_values_preserves_scalars_and_container_types(self):
+        import datetime
+        from collections import OrderedDict
+        date = datetime.date(2020, 7, 13)
+        original = OrderedDict([('key', [1, True, None, date, {'text': 'prefix-secret-suffix'}])])
+        result = remove_values(original, ['secret'])
+        self.assertIs(type(result), OrderedDict)
+        self.assertIs(result['key'][3], date)
+        self.assertEqual(result['key'][4], {'text': 'prefix-********-suffix'})
+        self.assertIs(remove_values(123, ['123']), 123)
+        self.assertEqual(remove_values('secret', ['secret']), '********')
+
+    def test_sanitize_keys_recursive_and_ignored(self):
+        from collections import OrderedDict
+        original = OrderedDict([('password', 'secret'),
+                                ('api-password-end', [{'password': 1, '_ansible-password': 2,
+                                                       'changed': 3, 'status': 4}])])
+        result = sanitize_keys(original, [b'password', b'status'], frozenset(('changed', 'status')))
+        self.assertIs(type(result), OrderedDict)
+        self.assertEqual(result, OrderedDict([
+            ('VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER', 'secret'),
+            ('api-********-end', [{'VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER': 1,
+                                   '_ansible-password': 2, 'changed': 3, 'status': 4}])]))
+        self.assertEqual(original['password'], 'secret')
+
+    def test_sanitize_keys_preserves_non_mapping_values(self):
+        import datetime
+        values = ['password', True, None, {1, 2}, [1, 2], (1, 2), datetime.date.today()]
+        for value in values:
+            self.assertEqual(sanitize_keys(value, ['password']), value)
+        self.assertEqual(sanitize_keys([{'x-password': 1}], ['password']), [{'x-********': 1}])
+        self.assertEqual(sanitize_keys({'items': ({'x-password': 1},)}, ['password']),
+                         {'items': ({'x-********': 1},)})
+        self.assertIs(type(remove_values(frozenset(('secret',)), ['secret'])), frozenset)
+
+    def test_deep_nesting(self):
+        original = {}
+        inner = original
+        for _ in range(10000):
+            inner['next'] = {}
+            inner = inner['next']
+        inner['secret-key'] = 'secret'
+        result = remove_values(original, ['secret'])
+        result = sanitize_keys(result, ['secret'])
+        for _ in range(10000):
+            result = result['next']
+        self.assertEqual(result, {'********-key': '********'})
